title_en: A girl stands in the meadows

lines.en: A girl stands, dear, a girl stands,

lines.cyr: моме стое, џанам, јуф ливади, јуф ливади.
lines.lat: mome stoe, džanam, juf livadi, juf livadi.
lines.en: a girl stands, dear, in the meadows, in the meadows.

lines.cyr: Дек' што стое, моме, дек' што стое,
lines.lat: Dek' što stoe, mome, dek' što stoe,
lines.en: Where she stands, girl, where she stands,

lines.cyr: дек' што стое, моме, сонце грее, сонце грее.
lines.lat: dek' što stoe, mome, sonce gree, sonce gree.
lines.en: where she stands, girl, the Sun shines, the Sun shines.

lines.cyr: В' раце држи, моме, в' раце држи,
lines.lat: V' race drži, mome, v' race drži,
lines.en: In her hands she holds, girl, in her hands she holds,

lines.cyr: в' раце држи, моме, огледало, огледало.
lines.lat: v' race drži, mome, ogledalo, ogledalo.
lines.en: in her hands she holds, girl, a mirror, a mirror.
She is looking at herself, girl, she is looking at herself,

lines.cyr: с' огледује, моме, и зборује, и зборује.
lines.lat: s' ogleduje, mome, i zboruje, i zboruje.
lines.en: she is looking at herself, girl, and says, and says.

lines.cyr: - Дал ме личе, Боже, дал ме личе,
lines.lat: - Dal me liče, Bože, dal me liče,
lines.en: - Am I pretty enough, God, am I pretty enough,

lines.cyr: дал ме личе, Боже, за невеста јуф недела.
lines.lat: dal me liče, Bože, za nevesta juf nedela.
lines.en: am I pretty enough, God, for a bride on Sunday.
